mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dot specifies the actual red-graph function value at x = 1. Right image: The dot includes the initial point of the linear branch defined for x ≥ 1.
Rationales: The feature specifies an isolated included ordered pair off the nearby curve in the left image and marks an endpoint included in the plotted branch in the right image. The solid red point below the open point at x = 1. The filled purple point at (1, 2) starting the descending branch.
